name: Namu Deep
seed: To trade knowledge without turning the Hollow Sea into a resource claim.
design: Pearl-gray axolotl, rose external gills, dark teal woven coat, amber mineral beads; humid habitat needs matter.
history: A harbor navigator from a long-established deep-water community, chosen as a rotating speaker for surface relations.
desire: To trade knowledge without turning the Hollow Sea into a resource claim.
contradiction: Withholds so much context that partners cannot tell a boundary from a threat.
relationships: Toma seeks passage; Eris manages surface descent; Ossa’s order holds an old partial chart.
arc: Explains a protected route without surrendering restricted nesting grounds, and accepts a visitor’s useful correction.
story_engine: A surface map omits an inhabited shoreline; a lost ship returns carrying the wrong season’s cargo.
writer_truth: Their city’s founding traditions disagree; no single recovered tablet settles whose family belongs.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
